Not conclusively for every sensor. NASA FIRMS reported **zero thermal detections intersecting the property** during the covered days from October 13 to November 12, 2026.

MODIS, VIIRS NOAA-20 and VIIRS NOAA-21 covered the full period, but VIIRS S-NPP data were unavailable from November 2 to November 6. The absence of detections also does not prove that no fire occurred; small, short-lived, cool or cloud-obscured fires may go undetected.
